verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts for an online filing flow is a fair question for a government immigration portal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any such windows, limits, or timeouts. The Start-up Visa application deadline (ircc-docs-5) is a program-level cutoff, not an online-flow constraint, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
